نممت (form I)
# نَمَمْتُ (namamtu) /na.mam.tu/: first-person singular past active of نَمَّ (namma)
# نَمَمْتَ (namamta) /na.mam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of نَمَّ (namma)
# نَمَمْتِ (namamti) /na.mam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of نَمَّ (namma)
# نُمِمْتُ (numimtu) /nu.mim.tu/: first-person singular past passive of نَمَّ (namma)
# نُمِمْتَ (numimta) /nu
